description: MPEG-1 Layer III joint stereo with six broken frames between valid ones: big_values 300 (above 288), window switching with the reserved block type 0, the Huffman tables 4 and 14 that do not exist, scalefactors longer than part2_3_length, and two that libmad rejects: scfsi on a channel with short blocks, and mid/side stereo with different block types in the two channels. Frames stay frames; each problem is reported once.
